name: Spring Lake Recreation Area
note: Ozark-St. Francis National Forest (Magazine Ranger District) campground on the 82-acre Spring Lake (CCC/WPA-built 1937), Yell County. 13 sites, 9 large enough for RVs/camping trailers; primitive (no hookups), bathhouse with showers, no-wake lake with swimming/fishing. FCFS. Open ~Memorial Day-Labor Day. Access: paved AR-307 then ~3 mi gravel FR 1602. RV Life unrated. --Claude

name: Dam Site RV Park (Bull Shoals)
note: Owned and operated by the City of Bull Shoals, at 1616 Bull Shoals Dam Site Blvd just below Bull Shoals Dam near the White River. 33 sites, water + 30/50-amp electric (one full-hookup), dump station, showers; boat launch within walking distance. Reservable online or via Bull Shoals City Hall; open ~Apr 15-Oct 15. Distinct from the USACE/state Bull Shoals Lake campgrounds. --Claude

name: Holiday Island Campground
note: Run by the Holiday Island Suburban Improvement District (a property-owner improvement district near Eureka Springs). 31 full-hookup sites (water/sewer/electric, 30/50A), restrooms, showers, pavilion; overlooks Table Rock Lake. Seasonal (about Apr-Oct). --Claude

name: Greer Lake Campground (Crow Wing State Forest)
note: State-forest campground of 31 drive-in primitive sites (no hookups) on Greer Lake; vault toilets, drinking water, sites fit rigs to ~35 ft. First-come, first-served (not reservable). Open ~May-Nov. --Claude

name: Schoolcraft State Park
note: Small rustic drive-in campground: 28 wooded back-in sites (no electric), vault toilets and drinking water, no showers/dump; back-ins fit rigs to ~40 ft. On the upper Mississippi River; camping mid-May to early Sept. Reservable via ReserveMN. --Claude

name: Snake River Campground - Chengwatana State Forest
note: 26 primitive drive-in sites on the Snake River, Chengwatana State Forest (managed by Wild River SP); medium ~30-ft RVs fit, larger rigs struggle on the loop road; vault toilets, drinking water. Open ~May 1 to end of deer season. First-come, first-served. --Claude

name: East Bearskin Lake Campground
note: Superior NF (Gunflint District), 25 sites on 643-acre East Bearskin Lake ~26 mi NW of Grand Marais; non-electric, vault toilets, drinking water, boat ramp at the campground; sites accommodate RVs/trailers to ~30 ft; reservable, open mid-May to late Oct. --Claude

name: Gull Lake Recreation Area
note: USACE St. Paul District, 40 sites at Gull Lake Dam (Mississippi River Headwaters) on Gull Lake near Brainerd; most sites electric (30/50 amp), dump station, bathhouses, swim beach, boat launch; large gravel pads fit big RVs; reservable; open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Leech Lake Recreation Area
note: USACE campground at the Leech Lake dam outlet on Portage Bay, in the Chippewa NF; 73 wooded electric sites (8 full-hookup) plus 4 walk-to tent sites, back-in with a few pull-throughs accommodating large RVs; flush toilets, showers, dump station, boat ramps. Reservable; open ~early May-late Oct. --Claude

name: Temperance River Campground (Superior NF)
note: Small Superior NF concession campground inland on the Temperance River off the Sawbill Trail (Cook Co 2) - NOT the Lake Superior state park of the same name. 9 pine-shaded pull-in sites, solar-pump water, vault toilets; $20/night, fee paid on site (concessionaire-run). Sites are moderately sized - some fit a 23-ft rig, larger rigs may not. Open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: Two Island Lake Campground
note: Superior NF campground on Two Island Lake (753 ac) NW of Grand Marais. 38 drive-in sites with water, vault toilets, trash, boat ramp; $22/night, fee paid on site. Sites are moderately sized - most fit a 23-ft rig, some larger rigs may not. Open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: West Seelye Bay Campground
note: Chippewa NF campground on Cut Foot Sioux Lake (connected to Lake Winnibigoshish), ~20 mi N of Deer River via Hwy 46 then Eagle Nest Rd (FR 2198). 22 drive-in sites, accommodates vehicles up to ~70 ft, boat ramp near East Seelye Bay picnic area. First-come, first-served; short season (closes after July 4 weekend). --Claude

name: Alexandria Shooting Park and RV Campground
note: 146 pull-through RV sites with water + 50-amp electric and a dump station; restrooms/showers, laundry, camp-kitchen pavilion; open May-Oct, sites to 50 ft. Run by the Alexandria Shooting Park (trap/skeet/3D archery ranges on site). Reservable by phone; also listed on Hipcamp. --Claude

name: Chester Woods Park
note: Olmsted County park on Bear Creek/Chester Lake in SE MN bluff country; 42 electric sites (30/50-amp) for RVs up to 50 ft, central water filling station + dump (no per-site water), restrooms, 4 camper cabins; lake with beach/fishing. Open ~mid-May to mid-Oct, reservable online. --Claude

name: Eveleth Veterans Lake Park Campground
note: City of Eveleth municipal campground on Ely Lake, ~1.5 mi S of town. RV/camper + tent sites with water & electric, back-in and pull-through; swimming beach, picnic shelters, dump. Open ~May 1-Sep 30, reservable by phone. City-government park. --Claude

name: Grand Casino Hinckley RV Resort
note: Casino-owned (Mille Lacs Band) dedicated RV resort at Hinckley; 271 full-hookup sites (20/30/50 amp, water, sewer, cable, tar pads, 60-ft spaces), indoor pool, arcade, 24-hr shuttle to casino. Open ~Apr-Nov. --Claude

name: Gun Lake Family Campground
note: Family-owned campground on Gun Lake near Palisade; 21 all-pull-through full-hookup sites (water/sewer/30-50 amp) - 15 seasonal + 6 short-term nightly ($35/night). On-site dock & nearby boat launch. Open ~May 1-Oct 31. --Claude

name: Hidden Bluffs Resort / Spring Grove KOA Journey
note: KOA Journey in Bluff Country SE of Spring Grove; full-hookup RV sites + cabins/tent, outdoor pool, mini-golf, trails, trout stream on-site. Publicly bookable through KOA (open ~May 1-Oct 5). TRA-owned but operates as a public KOA franchise. --Claude

name: Jackpot Junction Casino RV Park
note: Dedicated full-hookup casino RV park (Lower Sioux/Dakota-owned) just west of Jackpot Junction Casino. ~70 sites, concrete pads, full hookups 30/50 amp, 24+ pull-throughs, big-rig friendly (to 60 ft), bathhouse, dump. Open mid-Apr to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Lake Elmo Park Reserve
note: Washington County park reserve; modern campground with 80 electric-water sites (20/30 amp) plus 20 rustic back-in sites, dump station, sand-bottom swim pond (no full sewer). Open early May-mid Oct. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Lake Pepin Campground & Trailer Court
note: Private campground/trailer court (since 1966) across Hwy 61 from Lake Pepin; 44 sites (26 full + 18 partial hookup), big-rig friendly to ~45 ft, many pull-throughs, dump station. Mix of transient and seasonal. Open mid-Apr-mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Masonic West River Park
note: City of Hutchinson (PRCE) campground on the Crow River; ~24 sites - 14 full-hookup plus electric/water and tent sites, big-rig friendly, dump, boat landing, on the Luce Line Trail. Reservable. Open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Owen's Place RV Park
note: Small private RV park in the Chippewa NF at Marcell; 22 sites, 12 full-hookup pull-throughs, big-rig friendly to 40 ft. Open seasonally; reservations by phone or the website's contact form. Across the highway from Marcell town park. --Claude

name: Peaceful Valley Campsites
note: Family campground in a wooded valley near the Minnesota River, ~2 mi from Le Sueur; 36 sites (17 full-hookup, 18 water/electric, big-rig & pull-through), camp store, hot showers, laundry, dump; open Apr-Oct, reservable online. --Claude

name: Pipestone Family Campground
note: Prairie-region RV park across from Pipestone National Monument; 78 grassy sites, many full-hookup (30/50-amp) pull-throughs accommodating rigs to 80 ft, pool, camp store, dump; open May-Oct, reservable. --Claude

name: Prairie Lake Campground & RV Park
note: Campground on Prairie Lake, ~6 mi N of Grand Rapids off Hwy 38; 55 sites (26 full-hookup, big-rig) + 10 tent, swimming beach, boat ramp & rentals, showers, dump; open May-Sep, reservable online. --Claude

name: Prairie View RV Park & Campground
note: Full-hookup RV park beside Prairie's Edge Casino near Granite Falls (a dedicated casino RV resort, not a dry lot); 55 RV-only sites, 26 full-hookup pull-throughs to 75 ft, pool, fitness center, casino shuttle; open May-Oct, reservable. --Claude

name: Sands Country Cove Campground
note: Private campground on the west shore of Kansas Lake; 38 sites - 34 full-hookup 40x80 (20/30/50-amp) + 4 water/electric - plus 1 cabin, general store, playground. Open late Apr-mid Oct. Reservable (RoverPass). --Claude

name: McCullough Park & Campground (Shields Lake)
note: Rice County park on the SW shore of Shields Lake near Lonsdale (RV Life lists it as 'Shields Lake Campground'); 30 campsites - 20 with 30/50-amp water/electric + 10 seasonal - modern showers, RV dump, adjacent DNR boat access. Open May-Oct; reservable via Rice County. --Claude

name: Spafford Park Campground
note: City of Cloquet campground on the St. Louis River off Main St; 22 sites with water & sewer, pull-throughs + tent sites, updated showers, walk to downtown. Open ~mid-May-Oct; oriented to seasonal/monthly stays with nightly sites available. Reserve via Cloquet City Hall. --Claude

name: Sugar Bay Campground/Resort
note: Small 55+ RV resort on Pokegama Lake near Grand Rapids; 10 full-hookup sites (water/sewer/30-amp, 36-ft length limit), sand beach, marina, dump station. Open May-Oct. Reservable (RoverPass). --Claude

name: Sugar Point Resort
note: Resort on a Leech Lake point in Cass County; full-hookup RV sites plus 110 electric-only and primitive sites, seasonal cabins, shower house, protected harbor, indoor pool, playgrounds. Open early May-mid Oct. Reservable. --Claude

name: Sylvan Park Campground
note: City of Lanesboro campground in Sylvan Park on the Root River, walk to downtown and the Root River State Trail; 27 sites with electric & water + tent sites, bathhouse, dump station. First-come, first-served; pay at city office. Open ~Apr-Nov. --Claude

name: Alexander Ramsey Park Campground
note: City of Redwood Falls municipal park (largest in MN) campground inside a Redwood River bend; 31 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, many pull-through and big-rig friendly, dump station, showers, laundry. Reservable through Redwood Area Community Center. Season May-mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Baylor Regional Park
note: Carver County 201-acre regional park on Eagle Lake near Norwood Young America; 50 campsites (35 back-in with water + 30-amp electric, 15 primitive tent), dump/fill, showers, swim beach. Season May-Oct, reservable. --Claude

name: Benton Beach Campground
note: Benton County park on the north shore of Little Rock Lake, 2.5 mi E of Rice; 44 RV/tent sites with water and electric available, showers, dump station, lake access. First-come, first-served (no reservations). Open Fishing Opener through after Labor Day. --Claude

name: Big Falls Campground
note: City of Big Falls campground on the Bigfork River at Hwys 71/6 (Koochiching County); 32 sites with electric and water hookups plus primitive sites, indoor showers, WiFi, boat/canoe access; a separate horse-camp area adjoins. $35 hookup / $25 primitive, 7th night free. Open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Big Kandiyohi Lake County Park West
note: Kandiyohi County park on a peninsula in Big Kandiyohi Lake, 10 mi S of Willmar; 94 electric campsites, swim beach, boat access. Nightly and seasonal camping, online registration opens each January. Season May-Sept. --Claude

name: Big Stone County Toqua Park
note: Big Stone County park on Toqua Lake near Graceville (23390 Co Hwy 18); 18 sites with 20/30/50-amp hookups, swim beach, boat landing, showers, dump. Reservable; $25+/night, 7-night max. Closed Dec 1-Apr 24. --Claude

name: Cedar Lake Memorial Park
note: Community memorial park in Elmdale Township on Cedar Lake; 66 campsites (59 RV/trailer electric, 7 tent), water, showers, dump, 600 ft grass-beach swimming shoreline. Reservable; from ~$38/night. Open May-Sep. --Claude

name: Central Park Campground
note: City of Crookston riverside campground on the Red Lake River; full hookups (sewer/water + 20/30/50A) plus tent sites, bathhouse, 7-day max. First-come, first-served (no advance reservations); ranger collects fees ~6pm. Open May-Sep. --Claude

name: Crosby Memorial Park
note: City of Crosby park on Serpent Lake in town; 20 RV sites (back-in/pull-in) with full hookups (20/30/50A, sewer, water) plus 6 lakeside tent sites; restrooms/showers, no dump on-site. Reservable (Firefly). Open mid-May to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Dawson City Park Campground
note: City of Dawson park campground by the aquatic center on the Lac qui Parle River; 10 sites with full hookups (30A elec, water, sewer), bathhouse, dump, free WiFi. Reservations encouraged (call city office); open mid-Apr to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Fisherman's Point Campground
note: City of Hoyt Lakes municipal campground on a wooded peninsula. 93 sites with electric (no water/sewer at sites); filtered water fill station + free dump station, hot showers. Reservable online; season ~Apr 24-Sep 21. --Claude

name: Freeborn County Fairgrounds
note: Freeborn County fairgrounds in Albert Lea that also runs a seasonal full-hookup campground (50-amp water/electric/sewer, dump station) mid-April through mid-October, $25/night, campground host on site -- operates beyond fair week, not event-only. --Claude

name: Heritage Park & Campground
note: Town of Embarrass campground on the Embarrass River with canoe portage. 10 RV sites (30-amp + water, max RV ~40 ft) plus 6 tent sites, shower house; open May-September, $31/day. --Claude

name: Hole in the Mountain County Park
note: Lincoln County park on the west edge of Lake Benton, ~800 acres of woodland/prairie. 33 sites all with electric + water (RVs to ~33 ft), dump station, showers, hiking trails. Reservable, open mid-May through October. --Claude

name: Diamond Lake County Park (Kandiyohi County Park 3)
note: Kandiyohi County park on the west shore of Diamond Lake; ~60 campsites with electric, swimming beach, dump station and shelter. County takes reservations only for stays of 7+ nights; shorter stays first-come, first-served. Open May-Sept. --Claude

name: Lake Byllesby Regional Park Campground
note: Dakota County regional park campground on Lake Byllesby; 35 RV sites (incl. full-hookup pull-throughs, 30/50-amp) plus 22 tent sites, showers, dump. Reservable online, season May-Oct. Access via Harry Ave, not Gerlach Way (no RV clearance). --Claude

name: Lake Hanska County Park
note: Brown County park on Lake Hanska, ~17 mi SW of New Ulm; level electric campsites plus a large tent area, showers, dump, swimming beach, fishing pier. 5 sites reservable (up to 4 months ahead); rest first-come, first-served. Open mid-May-late Sept. --Claude

name: Lake Marion County Park
note: McLeod County park on the SE corner of Lake Marion, ~6 mi S of Hutchinson; 39 sites (RV/electric + tent/non-electric), showers, dump. Reservable online (max 14 nights), season late Apr-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Lake Ripley Campground
note: City of Litchfield campground on Lake Ripley; 32 shore-front sites (22 with full hookups water/elec/sewer), showers, dump, fish-cleaning shed. RVs up to 35 ft. Online reservation only, season mid-Apr-mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Land of Memories Campground
note: City of Mankato campground in Land of Memories Park along the Minnesota River; 36 sites (electric + non-electric), showers, dump, disc golf. Reservable online, seasonal (opens May). --Claude

name: Lebanon Hills Regional Park Campground
note: Dakota County regional park campground in Lebanon Hills; 93 sites in three areas incl. 58 full-hookup RV sites (30/50-amp), plus standard electric & non-electric, showers, dump. Reservable online, season May-Oct. RV Life mislabels this commercial; it is Dakota County. --Claude

name: Lofgren Memorial Park Campground
note: City of Littlefork park on the Little Fork River; 15 sites with 50-amp electric + water (no sewer; dump in town), bathhouse, boat access, canoe rentals. Reservable online, season ~May 15-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Long Lake County Campground
note: Clearwater County park on spring-fed Long Lake near Itasca State Park; 91 sites (electric, electric+water, and primitive tent), two pull-throughs for 35-ft+ rigs and most sites to 35 ft, dump. Phone reservations only. Open mid-May-mid-Sept. --Claude

name: Garvin County Park
note: Lyon County park in bur-oak woodlands along the Cottonwood River, ~13 mi S of Marshall; Lower & Upper campgrounds with 52 electric + 8 non-electric sites (plus a separate 22-site horse campground), showers, dump. Some sites reservable, rest first-come, first-served. Season mid-May-mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Robertson County Park
note: Jackson County park near Jackson (48804 715th St). 22 sites with electric and electric/water hookups (20/30-amp), fire pits, picnic tables, dump station at the entrance; open May-Oct, $20/night. Reservable via Jackson County (online, same system as the county's Loon Lake park). --Claude

name: Schroeder County Park & Campground
note: Wright County park on the NW shore of 837-acre Cedar Lake, 2 mi NE of Annandale. 50 overnight sites with electric hookups, modern restrooms/showers, dump station, swim beach, boat launch with dock, fishing pier. Electric $27.50-30, non-electric $18.50-20 + reservation fee; reservable, open late Apr-Sep. --Claude

name: Seven Mile Lake Park
note: Murray County park on the west side of Fulda First Lake within Fulda (900 S Lafayette Ave). 14 drive-in camp sites (first-come, first-served, pay on arrival) plus 5 long-term seasonal sites; restrooms with showers, sand swim beach, boat landing, picnic shelters, playground. Open May-Sep, 14-day max. --Claude

name: Sherin Memorial Park
note: City of Pelican Rapids park on the Pelican River (221 E Mill Ave); RV Life mislabels park_type as commercial but it is a municipal park. 10 electric RV sites + 1 non-electric tent site, water fill and sewer dump station, covered pavilion, paved paths, riverbank fishing. Electric $20, tent $15; reservable (open mid-Jan). Open ~May fishing opener to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Sportsman Park (Sleepy Eye)
note: City of Sleepy Eye municipal park on Sleepy Eye Lake (Hwy 4 N). 8 sites with electric/water/sewer full hookups plus tent areas; updated showers/restrooms, picnic shelter, fishing piers, boat launch, and a 5K paved trail circling the lake. Open mid-May to mid-Sep; reservations by phone. Distinct from the DB's 'Sportsman Park Camping' in Zumbro Falls. --Claude

name: St. Croix Bluffs Regional Park
note: Washington County 579-acre regional park on the St. Croix River, S of Hastings. 73 campsites - 26 RV-only pull-through sites with water + 50-amp electric, 11 tent-only, plus electric tent sites; new accessible shower building, boat launch, visitor center. Reservable (120-day window); $7 daily/$30 annual vehicle permit. No pets in the campground. Open early May-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Sunnybrook Park and Campground
note: Wadena city park on Whiskey Creek. 29 full-hookup RV sites (50-amp) plus 9 tent sites and 2 cabins; showers, dump. Reservable through the Wadena City Parks Dept. Open ~May 15-Oct 1. --Claude

name: Vermilion Trail Park Campground
note: City of Biwabik park on Embarrass Lake. 59 sites in 3 loops with electric/water (some full hookup), dump station; sandy beach, boat launch, fishing pier, on the Mesabi Trail. Open ~May 1-Sep 30, daily/seasonal rates. --Claude

name: Wildcat Park and Landing
note: Houston County park (leased from USACE) on the Mississippi River S of Brownsville. ~51 electric sites plus 35 seasonal and 8 primitive; central shower house, sandy beach, 2 boat landings, fishing pier. Open May-Sep, 2-night weekend minimum. --Claude

name: Zumbrota Covered Bridge Park
note: City of Zumbrota 80-acre park along the Zumbro River. RV/camper sites with water+electric ($40) and water/electric/sewer ($50), grass sites with utility posts; tent sites $25. First-come, first-served, open ~May 15-Nov 1. --Claude

name: Comanche Park Campground
note: USFS Black Hills National Forest campground in open ponderosa pine 6.5 mi W of Custer (closest campground to Jewel Cave NM). Drive-in sites accommodate RVs/trailers roughly 28-63 ft, no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water; open mid-May to early Sept, reservable via Recreation.gov. Not on water. --Claude

name: Rod & Gun Campground
note: Black Hills NF campground in Spearfish Canyon along Little Spearfish Creek, ~2.5 mi off US-14A at Savoy via Roughlock Falls Rd (gravel, can be rutty). 7 standard non-electric sites, tables/grills, potable water, vault toilet; accommodates RVs to ~30 ft. First-come, first-served; seasonal (closes ~Dec 1). --Claude

name: Cedar Pass Campground
note: NPS-concessioner (Cedar Pass Lodge) campground in Badlands National Park beside the Ben Reifel Visitor Center. 96 sites, ~75 accommodate RVs; 23 have 30/50-amp electric, no full hookups; septic dump station, flush toilets, pay showers. Open late March-mid-October; reservable online (recreation.gov). RV Life labels it commercial but it is a national-park campground -> ownership federal. --Claude

name: Broken Arrow Campground
note: Private full-service campground ~4 mi S of Custer with horse facilities but open to general RV camping: 40 pull-through RV sites, full hookups (some 30-amp, some 50-amp w/ sewer), plus tent sites, cabins, inn, general store. Open ~May 1-Oct 1; reservations by phone. --Claude

name: Country Cabins & RV Park
note: Seasonal (April-November) RV park and cabins at 2909 Country Dr, east of Mobridge near Lake Oahe: 26 RV sites (14 full-hookup 30/50-amp, 7 full-hookup 30-amp, 5 electric-only) with pull-throughs and parking for a boat, tent sites, 11 cabins and a cottage, a bathhouse of private rooms, laundry, clubhouse, wild-game cleaning room and freezer space; also pull-through areas for horse trailers. No online booking; call 605-845-2267. --Claude

name: Hav-A-Rest Campground
note: City of Redfield Parks & Rec campground on US-212 W beside Redfield Lake; two loops, 19 paved level electric (20/30/50-amp) pads plus tent area, dump station, showers, boat ramp/fishing dock, playground. Open ~Apr-Nov; register with the Parks 'n Rec office. Popular in pheasant season. --Claude

name: Prairie Pasque Campground
note: Small private full-hookup RV campground (formerly Watertown Mobile Estates) in SE Watertown; ~15 paved big-rig-friendly full-hookup sites, many pull-through, WiFi, laundry, dump station (restrooms, no showers). Nightly reservations on its website; open ~Apr-mid-Nov. --Claude

name: Lions Park Campground
note: City of Vermillion campground in Lions Park (Cherry & Princeton St); 10 electric/water sites, max RV ~40 ft, dump station, restrooms, playground; open Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Eureka City Park
note: City of Eureka lakeside park at the west edge of town, set between two lakes; 18 pads with 30/50-amp electric and a dump station, open Mar-Dec (weather permitting). First-come, first-served, $30/night. --Claude

name: Groton City Park Campground
note: City of Groton park campground (800 N Main St); ~12 electric sites (20-amp), accommodates RVs to ~45 ft, picnic tables, dump station; open May-Nov. Small municipal park with pool/playground nearby. --Claude

name: Lake Pocasse Campground (Campbell County)
note: Campbell County campground on the shore of Lake Pocasse near Pollock. About 13 RV-capable sites (plus tent/no-hookup sites), primitive: pit toilets, fire rings, grills, tables, playground and a boat ramp; max RV length ~32 ft. Open May-Sep, roughly $5/day; drive-in, reservations by phone with FCFS otherwise. --Claude

name: Little Missouri State Park
note: Badlands state park; it is one of ND's designated horse parks but also has a regular modern campground of 28 electric drive-in sites (plus 3 primitive), reservable online. Coin showers, vault toilets. Seasonal, open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Fort Buford State Historic Site Campground
note: Free primitive campground at Fort Buford State Historic Site (State Historical Society of ND) near the Missouri-Yellowstone confluence. ~10 sites, hand-pump water, vault toilet, no hookups; big rigs to ~35 ft reported. First-come, first-served; open ~May-Sept. --Claude

name: Hazen Bay Recreation Area
note: Hazen Parks & Recreation (city of Hazen) campground on Hazen Bay of Lake Sakakawea, ~15 mi N of Hazen (RV Life mis-tagged 'state' — it is a municipal rec area, ownership corrected to local). ~135 paved-access sites: 104 full-hookup, 25 water/electric, 6 electric, 6 primitive, 50-amp; boat ramps, showers, fish-cleaning station. Reservable online, open Memorial Day-late Sept. --Claude

name: Beaver Lake State Park
note: ND state park on Beaver Lake, ~5 mi SE of Wishek. Modern campground of 25 electric/water drive-in sites on an oval loop (a former half-mile horse-racing track), plus primitive sites and 3 lakeside camping cabins; showers, flush toilets, dump station, picnic shelters. Camping mid-May through Labor Day. Reservable online (95 days out) or by phone. --Claude

name: Sheep Creek Dam Recreation Area
note: Recreation area on 83-acre Sheep Creek Reservoir, ~5 mi S of the Hwy 21/49 junction then 0.5 mi W near Elgin (Grant County, county water-project area). About 10 primitive campsites, 5 with electric, on the reservoir's peninsula; one water spigot, one vault toilet, boat ramp and two fishing piers. First-come, first-served, no fee (donations encouraged); 5-day stay limit. Open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Downstream Campground
note: US Army Corps of Engineers (Garrison Dam) campground on the east bank of the Missouri River just below the dam at Riverdale. 98 electric sites (30/50-amp across three loops) plus a 16-site primitive loop; flush/vault toilets, showers, drinking water, dump station. Reservable on recreation.gov, season ~May 15-Sep 15; Loop 4 primitive is free FCFS in the off-season. --Claude

name: Hazelton Recreation Area
note: US Army Corps of Engineers campground on the east bank of the Missouri River / Lake Oahe, ~S of Bismarck near Hazelton (Emmons County). 18 primitive sites and 12 with 50-amp electric (electric sites take RVs up to ~67 ft); vault toilets, playground, boat ramp with paved lot and fish-cleaning station. 100% reservable (zero-day window) on recreation.gov, mid-May to mid-Sep; fees ~$14 nonelectric / $18 electric. --Claude

name: Eggerts Landing
note: USACE campground on Lake Ashtabula (Baldhill Dam on the Sheyenne River), the most popular of the Corps' Ashtabula recreation areas. 41 sites, 37 with electric; swimming beach, flush toilets, playground, dump station, fishing pier and boat ramp nearby. Reservable online, open ~May-Sept. --Claude

name: Jamestown Campground
note: Private RV park on a 25-acre property at the SE edge of Jamestown (3605 80th Ave SE). ~30 full-hookup pull-throughs (30/50-amp W/E/S) plus W/E, electric-only and tent sites; laundry, showers, playground, perimeter walking trail; 2 cabins. Reservable (season ~May 1-Sep 30). --Claude

name: Hillcrest Acres Campground
note: Private pull-through RV park at Bismarck I-94 exit 161 (5700 E Main Ave). 45 full-service sites (30/50-amp W/E/S) + 7 electric sites, all pull-through; laundry, showers, playground. Open ~April-Nov. Reservable. --Claude

name: Viking Vines RV Campground
note: Private vineyard RV park 2 mi off I-94 exit 317 near Buffalo, with on-site winery/tasting room in a restored granary. 14 spacious sites; courtyard, gazebo, horseshoes, walking trails; open ~May 1-Oct 14. Reservable. --Claude

name: Patterson Lake Recreation Area
note: Patterson Lake Recreation Area on Dickinson Reservoir (Edward Arthur Patterson Lake), operated by Dickinson Parks & Recreation. West-side modern loop has 21 electric/water sites (mostly 30-amp, two 50-amp; back-in ~36-40 ft, site 22 pull-through) plus ~30 primitive east-side sites; dump station, public beach, showers, playground. Reservable; season ~mid-May-Oct. --Claude

name: Lakeside Marina & Campground
season_source: note prose (cleaned out of the note 2026-10-13)
note: Stutsman County campground by Jamestown Reservoir, a Bureau of Reclamation lake, 2 miles north of Jamestown on Highway 20, with gravel sites for rigs up to 40 feet, four sleeping cabins, a swimming beach, fishing piers, boat ramps, a marina and a fish-cleaning station.  An island near the campground is open for day use. --Claude

name: LaMoure County Memorial Park
note: LaMoure County-operated park set on a James River oxbow just N of Grand Rapids. Electric/water sites, modern showers/restrooms, multiple dump stations, picnic tables, fire pits; ball fields, playground, 9-hole golf course adjacent. RVs to ~30 ft. First-come, first-served, Memorial Day-October. --Claude

name: Stonehouse RV Park
note: Family-operated in-town RV park in Stanley, across from Wilson Park; grass sites with full hookups (city water/sewer, 30 & 50 amp), garbage, lawn care/mosquito control. Open April-October; seasonal leases plus nightly transient. --Claude

name: Medina City Park Campground
note: City of Medina park 1 mile off I-94 exit 230; 26 RV sites with 30/50A electric and water, sewer dump, showers, playground. Honor-system self-registration (registration envelopes on site). Open early April to late November. --Claude

name: Tourist Park Campground (Valley City)
note: Valley City Park District campground on the east end of town adjacent to the Rainbow Bridge; 27 RV sites (17 with 50A), full hookups, restrooms and showers, shady. Reservable via the Park District office; open mid-May to mid-October. --Claude

name: Lewis and Clark RV Park (Hazen)
note: Hazen Parks & Recreation RV park on the west side of Hazen; 28 level pull-through sites, full hookups with 30/50A electric, comfort station with laundry, playground nearby. Seasonal May-September; reservable online. --Claude

name: Leistikow Park
note: Grafton Parks & Rec campground in Leistikow Park on the NW corner of Grafton near the Park River; 70 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp) plus 5 cabins, bathhouse and visitor center. Seasonal (water shut off ~Nov 1); reservable via Grafton Parks & Rec. --Claude

name: Willowood Campground
note: Mayville Park District campground on the Goose River off Hwy 200. 16 sites with water/electric (to 50-amp)/sewer, dump station, showers, swimming pool w/ slide, sand volleyball, playground, boat ramp, river fishing; max RV ~45 ft. Open May-Oct. --Claude

name: Walhalla Riverside Campground
note: City of Walhalla park (Riverside Park) on the Pembina River in the Pembina Gorge, adjacent to Pembina Gorge SRA. Electric/water RV sites (max RV ~28 ft) in two hookup areas plus a separate tent area; dump station (no site sewer), showers, swimming pool, playground, sand volleyball, Pembina River Water Trail launches. Open ~mid-May to early Sept. --Claude

name: Homme Dam Recreation Area
note: Walsh County Park Board recreation area on Homme Lake (South Branch Park River reservoir) ~2 mi W of Park River: 31 open grassy sites, electric with some full hookups, modern restrooms/hot showers, swimming beach and playground; rigs to 45 ft. First-come, first-served, $7/day or $35 season pass. Open May-Nov. --Claude

name: Neameyer Field Campground
note: Rolla city park campground beside the softball/football fields (Neameyer Field), a few blocks off Main St. About 12 RV sites, 6 with electric (30-amp, some 50), gravel; dump station and shower facilities; open ~May-Oct. First-come, first-served, ~$20/night, check in at the ARCO/Kooners station on Main Ave. --Claude

name: Sportsmen's Centennial Park Campground
note: McLean County park on the shore of Lake Sakakawea ~5 mi E and 3 mi S of Garrison; 97 sites (54 electric, 43 primitive), showers, swim beach, concessions, fish-cleaning station and boat ramp. Reservable online and by phone; primitive sites FCFS. Open Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Eagles Park & Campground
note: Bismarck Parks & Rec city campground on Hwy 1804 ~9 mi N of Pioneer Park (S of Double Ditch), on the Missouri River. 9 sites with 50-amp service and 60-ft gravel pads plus 20-amp back-in and grassy-field sites; 30 undesignated sites, reservable online/phone or FCFS, $10/night, May to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Kota Ray County Park
note: Williams County park at Kota Ray Dam, ~10 mi south of Ray; fully redesigned 2024/25 with refreshed electric/water campsites (20/30/50-amp), comfort stations with showers, 14 single sites plus 2 group sites (up to 3 RVs each). Reservable online (Mar-Nov, up to 13 nights). No-wake reservoir with boat/canoe launches. --Claude

name: Lidgerwood City Park
note: Lidgerwood city park campground (Richland County); 8 sites with electric/water hookups, restrooms and a pool; open May-Oct. Contact the city for camping. --Claude

name: Dead Colt Creek Recreation Area
note: Ransom County recreation area ~5 miles SE of Lisbon on the Dead Colt Creek reservoir; partial 20/30/50-amp electric hookups, dump station and bath house plus tent sites, with a swimming beach and fishing. Open May-Sept; sites reservable (Roverpass) with some FCFS. --Claude

name: Parshall Bay Recreation Area
note: Mountrail County recreation area on the NE corner of Lake Sakakawea's Van Hook Arm (Parshall Bay), ~100 campsites across three sections — ~50 electric hookups plus primitive camping — with showerhouse, vault toilets, three boat ramps, fish-cleaning stations and playgrounds. Mostly first-come, first-served (mid-May-mid-Sept); 12 long-term/seasonal spots reservable. --Claude

name: Trenton Lake Rec Area
note: Williams County recreation area ~15 mi SW of Williston on Trenton Lake (a Missouri River oxbow). ~20 sites with level concrete pads and full hookups, small store, two basic cabins, boat ramp/dock; open Memorial Day-Labor Day, reservable by phone, ~$35 full hookup. --Claude

name: Canoe Launch Campground (Chouteau County Fairgrounds)
note: Chouteau County Fair-operated campground in Fort Benton beside the Missouri River canoe launch (river mile 0 of the Upper Missouri Breaks); a separate site from the fair's ChoCoFair Campground at the fairgrounds. Free day-use parking by the launch ramp for boaters and floaters; the launch is a popular summer tubing spot. Seasonal (May-Nov). --Claude

name: Lewis & Clark RV Park

note: Private RV park at Shelby (I-15 Exit 364), ~72 mi E of Glacier NP's east entrance and 34 mi S of the Canadian border; across the street from Lake Shel-Oole and the Roadrunner Recreation Trail, 1.5 mi from downtown. --Claude

name: Lake Como Campground

season.note: Forest Service: 'Peak Season: Memorial Day - Labor Day. Non-Peak Season: Weather Dependent.' The page carried a 'Site Closed' banner on 2026-10-22.

note: Bitterroot NF, Lake Como Recreation Area between Darby and Hamilton. 'Lower Como': a paved loop under mixed pine and fir just below the Lake Como dam; the swim beach, loop trail and motorized boat launch are in the recreation area. --Claude

name: Rexford Bench Campground

name: Piney Campground

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, Pintler Ranger District, on Georgetown Lake ~13 mi south of Philipsburg off MT-1 (Georgetown Lake Road, 2 mi past the dam). Paved roads, boat ramp and day-use picnic area; overlooks the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness. --Claude

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF campground (Pintler RD) on Georgetown Lake, about 11 mi south of Philipsburg, overlooking the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness. Paved roads and a boat ramp. --Claude

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD) campground ~11 mi W of Anaconda on Hwy 1, ~8 mi from Georgetown Lake, in lodgepole pine near Warm Springs Creek; day-use picnic area. --Claude

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Dillon RD) campground on the south shore of Reservoir Lake at ~7,000 ft, ~18 mi up gravel Bloody Dick Rd (FR 181) from Highway 324, plus a day-use picnic area. Campendium flags big-rig access. --Claude

name: Riverview Campground

season.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually, late May through mid-October, weather dependent.'

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) campground at ~6,000 ft on an open sagebrush bench overlooking the Madison River (~1/4 mi east) and the Madison Range, about 34 miles south of Ennis on Hwy 287 near Cameron. The Forest Service calls it 'RV friendly'. --Claude

name: South Fork Campground

season.note: Forest Service: 'Availability depends on road access.'

note: USFS (Helena-Lewis & Clark NF, Rocky Mountain RD) campground 31 mi W of Augusta on gravel FR 235, on the South Fork Sun River at a Bob Marshall Wilderness trailhead. General campground with horse/hiker trail access (not equestrian-only). Mandatory food storage (bears). --Claude

name: Whitehouse Campground

Continental Divide Trail trailheads within 5 mi. --Claude

name: Wood Lake Campground

season.note: Forest Service: 'Varies-late spring to early fall. Contact District Office to verify status.'

note: USFS (Helena-Lewis and Clark NF, Rocky Mountain Ranger District) campground 24 mi west of Augusta on Benchmark Road 235, beside Wood Lake (fishing and swimming; no motorboats); hiking trails skirt the camp. Bear country. --Claude

note: USFS (Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, Dillon RD) campground in shady lodgepole pine at ~7,870 ft on the Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway (Road 73), 1/4 mi up FS Rd 2406 and 1.5 mi south of Crystal Park. No cell service. --Claude

name: Lowland Campground and Picnic Area

From Harrison, about 7 miles west on Pony Road, then 10 miles south on South Willow Creek Road from Pony. No cell coverage. A 23-ft motorhome is just over the Forest Service's 22-ft trailer recommendation, which the curation rule accepts. --Claude

note: Along Logging Creek below limestone cliffs in the NE Little Belt Mtns, Helena-Lewis and Clark NF, ~15 mi off the US-89 corridor: from Great Falls 32 mi S on US 89, 14 mi SW on Evans-Riceville Rd, ~2 mi S on FR 839. Renovated in 2025 adding pull-throughs; many sites creekside. Popular with OHV riders (Deep Creek OHV trailhead ~5 mi south; no riding in the campground). Cutthroat catch-and-release. No cell service; access road narrow/potholed in spots. Distinct from Glacier NP's Logging Creek. --Claude

name: Connor Battlefield State Historic Site
note: Wyoming State Parks historic site in Ranchester, on a Tongue River oxbow. ~13-20 drive-in camp/picnic sites (tents, trailers, RVs), grills, tables, drinking water, flush toilets; no hookups. First-come, first-served; open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: Atlantic City Campground
note: BLM Lander FO campground near the historic town of Atlantic City / South Pass. 18 sites among trees, a few pull-throughs, most fit RVs to ~30 ft; vault toilets, seasonal water, tables, fire rings; no dump. $20/night, first-come, first-served, ~Jun 1-Oct 31. --Claude

name: Soda Lake (WHMA) Campground
note: Wyoming Game & Fish Dept WHMA ~5 mi NW of Pinedale via Soda Lake/Willow Lake Rd. Free dispersed camping around the lake perimeter: ~20 sites with tables and fire rings, several vault toilets, no water/trash; firm-packed dirt road passable to 2WD. 14-day limit, open ~May 1-Dec 1. First-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Teton Reservoir Campground
note: BLM Rawlins Field Office recreation site ~13 mi south of Rawlins off WY-71. Free, first-come, first-served: 5 campsites with picnic tables, fire rings and parking spurs (no pull-throughs), vault toilets and a boat ramp on Teton Reservoir. Use season ~June 1-Nov 15; access roads turn to mud when wet. --Claude

name: Cottonwood Campground (Green Mountain)
note: BLM Lander Field Office campground in a semi-alpine setting on Green Mountain, ~10 mi S of Jeffrey City via Green Mountain Rd (BLM 2411, improved gravel). 18 developed sites with tables, fire rings, potable water and vault toilets; accommodates large RVs; season ~June 1-Oct 31. A 2025 culvert failure temporarily limited trailer access - verify road status before towing. --Claude

name: Big Atlantic Gulch Campground
note: BLM Lander Field Office campground ~3 mi N of Atlantic City, 1 mi off WY-28. 10 sites with tables, fire rings, vault toilets and water (weather permitting); accommodates medium-sized RVs; ADA accessible; season ~June 1-Oct 31; ~$20/night. --Claude

name: Prior Flat Campground
note: BLM Rawlins Field Office campground at the foot of the Shirley Mountains via CR-102 and Shirley Mountain Loop Rd (BLM 3115). 15 sites (one pull-through) with tables, fire rings and vault toilet; max RV length ~25 ft; season ~June 1-Nov 15 (roads impassable when wet). Fishing on nearby Sage Creek. No fee. --Claude

name: Scab Creek Campground
note: BLM Pinedale Field Office recreation area in the Wind River foothills, ~7 mi E of Boulder off WY-353. Two free campgrounds - a Large Vehicle Campground (7 sites for trailers/large RVs) and a Small Vehicle Campground - with tables, fire rings, vault toilets, potable water and corrals; trailhead to the Bridger Wilderness; closed ~Nov 15-Apr 30. --Claude

name: Firehole Canyon Campground (Ashley NF, Flaming Gorge)
note: Ashley NF campground on the NE shore of Flaming Gorge Reservoir, ~10 mi off Hwy 191 near McKinnon. 36 sites for RVs/trailers to 35 ft; flush toilets, showers, drinking water, dump station; no hookups. Reservable online; open ~mid-May to mid-Sep. --Claude

name: Bridge Bay Campground (Yellowstone NP)
note: Large NPS campground on a rise above Bridge Bay Marina on Yellowstone Lake. ~432 sites, RVs/trailers to 40 ft, flush toilets, dump station, no hookups. Reservable through Yellowstone NP Lodges; open ~late May to mid-Sep. --Claude

name: Canyon Campground (Yellowstone NP)
note: Large NPS campground in lodgepole forest at Canyon Village, ~7,900 ft. 272 sites, RVs/trailers to 40 ft, flush toilets, showers/laundry nearby, no hookups. Reservable through Yellowstone NP Lodges; open ~late May to mid-Sep. --Claude

name: Colter Bay RV Park (Grand Teton NP)
note: NPS concessioner (Grand Teton Lodge Company) full-hookup RV park at Colter Bay Village, Jackson Lake. 114 hookup sites — 102 pull-through to 45 ft, 12 back-in to 30 ft (combined RV+tow). Reservable through GTLC; open ~late May to late Sep. Public RV park (RV Life $$$$ reflects full hookups, not a private/membership gate). --Claude

name: Fishing Bridge RV Park (Yellowstone NP)
note: NPS concessioner full-hookup RV park near Yellowstone Lake at Fishing Bridge (rebuilt; hard-sided units only, no tents/pop-ups due to bear activity). ~310 pull-through/back-in hookup sites. Reservable through Yellowstone NP Lodges; open ~late May to Sep. Public RV park (RV Life $$$$ reflects full hookups, not a private/membership gate). --Claude

name: Buckboard Crossing Campground (Ashley NF, Flaming Gorge)
note: Ashley NF campground on the NW shore of Flaming Gorge Reservoir, ~25 mi S of Green River on Hwy 530 then 2 mi E on FR 009, adjacent to Buckboard Marina; high-desert sagebrush, little shade, ~6,100 ft. 58 sites for RVs/trailers 20-45 ft, 8 electric sites in loop A; drinking water, boat ramp/marina nearby. Reservable online; open ~mid-May to mid-Sep. --Claude

name: Lizard Creek Campground (Grand Teton NP)
note: NPS campground (operated by Signal Mountain Lodge) at the north end of Jackson Lake off US-89/191/287, ~32 mi N of Moose. 60 wooded sites; max RV 30 ft / trailer 20 ft, vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. Reservable through recreation.gov; open ~June to early Sep. --Claude

name: Grant Village Campground (Yellowstone NP)
note: Large NPS campground in lodgepole forest near the SW (West Thumb) shore of Yellowstone Lake, ~7,800 ft. ~430 sites, RVs/trailers to 40 ft, flush toilets, showers/laundry/dump nearby, no hookups. Reservable through Yellowstone NP Lodges; open ~June to mid-Sep. --Claude

name: Gros Ventre Campground (Grand Teton NP)
note: Large NPS campground (operated by Grand Teton Lodge Company) along the Gros Ventre River near Kelly, SE corner of the park; cottonwood flats and sage. ~300 sites, back-in/pull-through gravel pads to 45 ft (RV+tow), some electric sites; flush toilets, dump station. Reservable through recreation.gov; open ~May to mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Six Mile Campground
note: Medicine Bow NF near Encampment, in a high-desert saddle above the North Platte River (blue-ribbon trout stream). 9 sites (6 reservable, 3 pull-thru), max RV 30 ft; vault toilets, fire rings, no hookups, no shade. Open mid-June to mid-Sept. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Tie Flume Campground
note: Bighorn NF off the Bighorn Scenic Byway (US-14) near Burgess Overlook, ~8,400 ft. 27 sites in 2 loops, average spur 60 ft (30-120 ft), some pull-throughs; vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. Open early June to mid-Sept, reservable online. --Claude

name: Fiddlers Lake Campground
note: Shoshone NF campground on the shore of Fiddlers Lake in the Wind River Mtns, off the Loop Rd (FR 300) SW of Lander at ~9,400 ft. 20 sites, potable water, vault toilets, no hookups; max spur ~40 ft. First-come, first-served, $20 (cash/check); open ~June-Sept. --Claude

name: Fox Creek Campground
note: Shoshone NF campground on the Beartooth Hwy (US-212) ~7 mi E of Cooke City MT / 11 mi from Yellowstone's NE entrance, near Fox Creek. Recently renovated: 33 sites incl 27 with electric, drinking water, vault toilets, no dump/showers; max RV ~32 ft. Views of Pilot & Index peaks; open ~June-mid-Sept. --Claude

name: Horse Creek Campground
note: Shoshone NF (Wind River RD), 9-site campground on Horse Creek ~12 mi N of Dubois via FR-285. First-come, first-served; vault toilets, hand-pump drinking water, bear boxes; no hookups. Max spur ~32 ft. Open ~late May-early Sept. --Claude

name: Island Lake Campground
note: Shoshone NF, 21 remodeled sites at ~9,500 ft on Island Lake along the Beartooth All-American Hwy (US-212). First-come, first-served; potable water, vault toilets, bear boxes, pack-it-in/out; boat ramp. Sites accommodate RVs/trailers to ~32 ft. Seasonal (late May-mid Oct). --Claude

name: Lincoln Park Campground
note: Medicine Bow NF (Brush Creek/Hayden RD), ~20 mi E of Saratoga off FR100. 12 non-electric sites in two loops at ~8,100 ft, max RV ~32 ft; potable water/vault toilets, mid-June-Sept. Reservable via recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Pole Mountain Dispersed Camping Area
note: Medicine Bow NF, Pole Mountain/Vedauwoo unit - ~97 designated dispersed sites on hard-gravel FR700 (2WD, wide enough for RVs to pass) off Vedauwoo Glen Rd. Rock fire rings only, no water/toilets/trash; most sites fit large RVs (some spurs rutted). Free, first-come, first-served, 16-day limit; road closed Feb-May. --Claude

name: Lazy Acres Campground & Motel
note: Grassy campground on the Encampment River in Riverside; RV sites with 30/50-amp electric + water/sewer, tent sites, 4 motel rooms, new shower house/laundry/dump; seasonal ~May 15-late Sep. --Claude

name: Larson Park Campground (Trail Ruts Golf & Camp)
note: City of Guernsey campground attached to the municipal Trail Ruts nine-hole golf course, beside the North Platte River near the Oregon Trail Ruts and Register Cliff. 15 RV sites on shared 30/50A power pedestals (some with water), shower house; open ~April-October. --Claude

name: Saratoga Lake Campground
note: Town of Saratoga campground on Saratoga Lake, 1 mi north of town: 50 electric (30/50A) sites and 34 non-electric, big-rig capable, sandy swim beach and boat access; water is non-potable. First-come, first-served (open May-Oct, plus the January ice-fishing derby). --Claude

name: Cottonwood at Torrington Golf Course RV Park
note: City of Torrington-owned Cottonwood municipal golf course that also offers RV camping (electric hookup sites near the clubhouse), open roughly the golf season (Apr 1-Nov 1). Book/confirm sites through the pro shop. --Claude

name: Hatbox RV Park (Muskogee)
note: Municipal RV park at the Hatbox Event Center (former Hatbox Field), operated by City of Muskogee Parks & Rec. 150+ pull-in slips with full hookups (50-amp electric, water, sewer, wifi); open to the public for transient camping at $30/night ($175/week), booked online via Firefly. Flat former airfield, fits big rigs. Seasonal: closed ~Nov 15-Mar 10. --Claude

name: Quarry Island Campground - Lake Wister State Park
note: Quarry Island Campground on a peninsula at Lake Wister State Park. 5 full-hookup RV sites plus 2 water/electric RV sites (level concrete pads), plus tent sites, boat ramp, dump station; open ~March-November. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Taylor Ferry South
note: USACE (Tulsa District) campground in oak-hickory forest on the main body of Fort Gibson Lake. 95 sites, 89 with electric (30/50-amp) + water, 6 primitive; flush/vault toilets, showers, dump station, boat ramp; swim beach across the highway. Open ~Mar-Oct. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Applegate Cove Campground
note: USACE (Tulsa District) campground on Robert S. Kerr Reservoir (Arkansas River) about 8 miles south of Sallisaw. 27 sites with electric + water, comfort station with showers, boat ramp and courtesy dock; camping season ~Mar-Oct (day-use only from Dec 1). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Osage Cove
note: USACE Kaw Lake campground 9 mi E of Ponca City across Kaw Dam; ~97 sites with electric (RVs to 60 ft), water, flush toilets, boat ramp, mostly shaded; seasonal (Mar-Sep). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Pettit Bay
note: USACE campground on Tenkiller Ferry Lake near Gore; 92 sites (13 primitive, most 30-amp, several 50-amp and a few full-hookup), flush toilets, hot showers, swim beach, dump station, boat ramps with courtesy docks and an adjacent marina; open Jan-Sep. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Redbud Bay
note: USACE campground on Oologah Lake near the dam; 11 sites all with 30-amp electric/water, pit toilets on site (flush toilets, showers and dump station are across the dam at Hawthorn Bluff at no extra fee), boat launch; seasonal Apr-Oct. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Guy Sandy Campground
note: NPS Chickasaw NRA primitive campground on the western shore of Lake of the Arbuckles; ~40 sites, RVs permitted (limit ~40 ft) but no hookups, water spigots + pit toilets, fire rings, boat access. Open seasonally (about Memorial Day-Labor Day), first-come, first-served, not reservable. --Claude

name: Feyodi Creek RV Park
note: City of Cleveland park on the south shore of Keystone Lake, ~2.5 mi S of town. Numerous drive-in RV sites (full hookup + water/electric-only) plus tent camping; bathhouse w/ showers, boat ramp, disc golf, amphitheater. Open ~March-November; reserve via park attendant. Distinct city-run park, not one of the USACE Keystone Lake campgrounds. --Claude

name: Bear Creek Campground (Benbrook Lake)
note: USACE Fort Worth District campground in Mustang Park on the south side of Benbrook Lake. 46 individual standard-electric sites plus a group site; restrooms with showers, dump station, boat launch. Open April-September; reservable online. Check-in 3 PM. --Claude

name: Flatrock Park (Hords Creek Lake)
note: USACE Fort Worth District campground on Hords Creek Lake, ~8 mi west of Coleman off Hwy 153. Paved level loops with 50+ water/electric sites (mix of 30/50-amp; ~10 full-hookup), two dump stations, boat ramps, swim beach and fishing piers; most sites back toward the lake. Open peak season (about May–Sept). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Westcliff Park (Belton Lake)
note: USACE Fort Worth District park on the SW shore of Belton Lake. 26 single RV sites plus 1 tent site with 50-amp electric and water, and 4 primitive tent-only sites (water only). Waterborne restroom w/ showers, dump station, multi-lane boat ramp, swim beach, playground. Camping season is roughly Mar 1-Oct 1. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Wolf Creek Park (Navarro Mills Lake)
note: USACE Fort Worth District park on the north shore of Navarro Mills Lake. ~50 sites with water and electric hookups, 22 non-electric sites, 2 double sites, 1 group site; restrooms w/ showers, dump station, fishing pier, group picnic shelter, two-lane boat ramp. Camping season roughly April-Sept. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Clear Creek Campground
note: USFS Santa Fe National Forest campground in the Jemez Mountains, ~11 mi E of Cuba on NM-126 (RV Life mistags it 'state' — it is Forest Service). 12 sites with paved RV pads, fire rings, tables and vault toilets; paved loop roads accommodate RVs up to ~47 ft. $20/night; reservable via Recreation.gov in season (opens May, closes mid-October). Fishing on local streams and nearby San Gregorio Reservoir. --Claude

name: Riana Campground - Abiquiu Lake
note: USACE campground on a bluff overlooking Abiquiu Lake, ~1 hr NW of Santa Fe. 52 sites; 13 electric/water hookup sites on the paved Pedernal loop suited to larger RVs, standard non-electric sites take trailers/RVs to ~30 ft. Flush toilets, showers, dump station. Open ~Apr 15-Oct 15, reservable online. Alcohol-free. --Claude

name: McGaffey Campground (Cibola NF)
note: Cibola NF campground in the Zuni Mountains, ~8 mi south of Fort Wingate on SR-400 (Exit 33 off I-40), at ~7,800 ft near McGaffey Lake. 29 drive-in sites plus 3 group sites and picnic area; vault toilets, no hookups or potable water, open seasonally mid-May-Sep. The FS page's 'trailers under 22 ft' is a conservative turnaround caveat — Campendium reviewers report level sites fitting rigs to ~40 ft. Individual sites FCFS; group sites reservable. --Claude

name: Holy Ghost Campground
note: Santa Fe NF campground in Holy Ghost Canyon along Holy Ghost Creek, 16 mi N of Pecos via NM-63 then FR 122; 23 single sites, vault toilets, no potable water, no hookups. First-come, first-served (the separate Holy Ghost Group Area is reservable online). Opens roughly mid-May to mid-Oct; reopened and operating after the 2022 Hermits Peak/Calf Canyon fire. FR 122 is narrow — trailers over ~25 ft not advised, so a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude

name: Jacks Creek Campground
note: Santa Fe NF campground of ~39-44 drive-in sites in two loops near the Pecos Wilderness at ~8,900 ft; no hookups, no potable water (new water system pending). Max RV ~25 ft with several sites fitting 23-ft-plus rigs (e.g. site 11), though the approach road (NM-63/FR-555) is narrow. First-come, first-served, open May-Oct. --Claude

name: McCrystal Campground
note: Carson NF campground in the Valle Vidal unit at ~8,100 ft, reached via ~28 mi of gravel (FR-1950) from Cimarron; 60 sites accommodating trailers to 32 ft, vault toilets, no potable water. First-come, first-served, open mid-spring through fall (Valle Vidal east side closed Jan 1-Mar 31 for elk winter range). --Claude
